limitations: Force-stop delivery is image-specific; not a general availability guarantee.
Native replay detection is process-local and bounded to 32 IDs; headless replay invokes JavaScript again.
No durable inbox, production mutation, encrypted binding, or runtime socket exercised.
Emulator results above cover only those images; physical observations are separately bounded in physical. Battery/latency budgets, release/Play signing and multi-node isolation remain untested.
Headless uses Expo-generated minSdk 24 and targetSdk 36, exercised on emulator API 31; physical build/install API 36 recorded separately; it is not the product manifest contract.
Unhandled-path timeout is not evidence for an offline durable queue.
